privacy.delete.body: A teacher can delete a student or a class on the class page — it is deleted at once and for good, and a deleted student's points leave the rankings. Deleting the account in Settings → Profile deletes all of the teacher's classes, students and games too. A parent can ask the teacher to delete their child's data.
privacy.delete.title: How to delete it
privacy.google.body: When someone signs in with Google, Google sends Elifba the account holder's name and e-mail address. When the account is created, this name and address are written to it (the name can be changed later). Apart from that, Elifba keeps only the Google account's number, to recognise the account next time. No picture or other information is kept. Nothing about the children is ever sent to Google. Signing in with Google is a choice: signing up with an e-mail address and a password works too.
privacy.google.title: Signing in with Google
privacy.home.delete: A parent can delete a child on the child's page: the name, the avatar, the games and the stars are deleted at once and for good. There is no archive. Deleting the account in Settings → Profile deletes the children too.
privacy.home.how_long: A child is kept until the parent deletes them. Games older than :days days are deleted automatically, with their stars.
privacy.home.not_shared: Children are never compared: there is no ranking, place or picture to share. A parent's child and a teacher's student are never linked — even for the same child they are separate records, and a teacher never sees what was played at home.
privacy.home.stored:
Parent: the account's details (name, email address, a hash of the password, the interface language) and when the parent's agreement was given.
Child: a first name only (no surname), an animal avatar, the parent's order and the learned letters. At most :max children.
Games: which game was played when, which rounds were solved and the stars earned.
A child's surname, photo, date of birth, age, gender, school or contact details are never stored.
privacy.home.title: At home: parents and their children
privacy.home.who: Only the parent's own account sees a child's name and stars; the name is shown only on the board of that parent's game.
privacy.home.why: A parent adds their own children, because the parent is the one who may decide for them. The name and the avatar show who is playing on the board, and the stars show the child's own progress.
privacy.how_long.body: Classes and students are kept until the teacher deletes them. Archived classes and students are deleted automatically after :days days, and games older than :days days are deleted with their points.
privacy.how_long.title: For how long
privacy.intro: Elifba helps teachers run reading games in class, and parents play reading and picture games with their own children at home. Children never use the app themselves and have no accounts. Only what the games need to work is stored.
privacy.not_stored.body: No child's surname, patronymic, photo, birth date, gender, address, phone number or ID number is stored. When a teacher pastes a list of names, surnames are read only to suggest the first names and are kept nowhere. Children never log in and are never asked for anything.

privacy.operator.unknown: The operator of this instance has not published contact details. If you have questions, ask whoever gave you this address, or your school.
privacy.parents.description: Before you use Elifba with your class, you can copy this text and send it to parents.
privacy.parents.note:
Dear parents,

In our lessons we will use Elifba reading games to help the children learn to read. The children play on the classroom board; they never log in to the app or type anything into it.

For each child, Elifba keeps only a first name (with a surname initial when needed) and an animal avatar. No surname, photo or contact details are stored. Game points are only for encouragement within the class. If a child's first name is in Elifba's name list, the board may say it with the praise in a prerecorded voice; the name is sent nowhere.

The data is deleted automatically after :days days, and you can ask me at any time to delete your child's data sooner. We use Elifba with the school's permission.

If you have any questions, please write to me.
privacy.parents.selected: The text is selected — press Ctrl+C (⌘+C on a Mac) to copy it.
privacy.parents.title: A note for a class's parents
privacy.stored.body:
Teacher: name, email address, a hash of the password and the interface language.
Class: the teacher's name for it (for example “1A”), its grade and the letters it has learned.
Student: a first name only (with a surname initial when two children share a name), an animal avatar and their place in the class order.
Games: which game was played when, which student solved which round, and the points they earned.
privacy.stored.title: What is stored
privacy.title: Privacy note
privacy.voice.body: The board says the prompt and the praise in a prerecorded voice. When a student's or a child's first name is in Elifba's built-in name list, the board may say it in that voice with the praise, at the start of a game at home and at the end of a game. The name is sent to no service and nothing is stored for it; a name that is not in the list is only shown in writing. It can be turned off in Settings → Games.
privacy.voice.title: The board's voice
privacy.where.body: Everything is kept on this Elifba instance's own server. Its pages make no requests to outside services: no ads, analytics, web fonts or trackers.
privacy.where.title: Where it is kept
privacy.why.body: Names and avatars show whose turn it is at the board; points make the class's daily and weekly rankings. The data is not used for advertising, analytics or anything else, and is given to no one.
privacy.why.title: Why

welcome.get.words_text: Add your own words to the themes and hide built-in words you don't want.
welcome.hero.how: A child touches a letter on the wall, you tap the same letter on your phone, and the wall answers at once.
welcome.hero.parents: A parent? Play at home with your child too
welcome.hero.title: Teach reading with games on the classroom wall.
welcome.hero.who: Elifba is made for primary-school teachers and is free.
welcome.lesson.class.alt: The 1A class page in Elifba: the students' names and animal pictures.
welcome.lesson.class.text: Paste your students' names as a list: each child appears only as a first name and an animal picture, with no account.
welcome.lesson.class.title: Set up the class
welcome.lesson.play.alt: Letters on coloured balloons on the board, with the task to find the letter «Ö» above them.
welcome.lesson.play.remote_alt: The remote on the teacher's phone: buttons for the letters on the board and the name of the child at the board.
welcome.lesson.play.text: Open the board on the computer connected to the projector and pair your phone as a remote with a QR code or a 6-digit code.
welcome.lesson.play.title: Play on the wall
welcome.lesson.play.turn: A child touches the wall, you tap the same thing on your phone, and the child at the board earns points.
welcome.lesson.setup.alt: The game setup page: the kind of game, the theme and the level.
welcome.lesson.setup.text: Pick the kind of game, the theme, the level and the number of rounds.
welcome.lesson.setup.title: Choose a game
welcome.lesson.share.alt: The day's winners: the top three with their names, animal pictures and points.
welcome.lesson.share.text: Every class has a daily and a weekly ranking, and you can post a picture of the top three to your WhatsApp status.
welcome.lesson.share.title: Share the winners
welcome.lesson.title: How a lesson goes
welcome.meta.description: A free platform for primary-school teachers: children learn letters, syllables, words and sentences by playing on the projected classroom wall while the teacher runs the game from a phone.
welcome.meta.image_alt: A find-the-letter game on the classroom wall: letters on coloured balloons.
welcome.meta.title: Elifba: reading games on the classroom wall
welcome.parents.alt: A home game on the board: «zürafə» hansıdır? (which one is the giraffe?) over a giraffe and a cat, with Tural playing in the corner.
welcome.parents.child.text: You type a first name and pick an animal picture; no class is needed.
welcome.parents.child.title: Add your child
welcome.parents.pictures: Picture games for children who cannot read yet
welcome.parents.pictures_text: Your child finds the picture you name, counts pictures and learns the digits. In these themes:
welcome.parents.play.text: Open the board on a computer or a tablet, then pair your phone as the remote or touch the screen. You read the task aloud to your child.
welcome.parents.play.title: Play together
welcome.parents.reading_text: Every reading game of the classroom is there at home too, built only from the letters your child has learned.
welcome.parents.remote_alt: The remote on the parent's phone: buttons for the giraffe and the cat, the answer marked, and the name of the child playing.
welcome.parents.role.text: After you register, Elifba asks who you are. If you also teach, you add the second role later in Settings.
welcome.parents.role.title: Choose “Parent”
welcome.parents.stars_text: Each child collects their own stars. Brothers and sisters are never compared: at home there is no ranking and there are no winners.
welcome.parents.text: You can play Elifba without a class too. A child who cannot read yet plays with pictures, and a child who is starting to read plays the letter and word games.
welcome.parents.title: At home, with your child
welcome.privacy.link: The privacy notice and the note for parents
welcome.privacy.text: Only a child's first name and an animal picture are kept; there is no photo, e-mail or account.
welcome.privacy.title: What is kept about children
welcome.privacy.wire: Pages send nothing to outside services: there are no ads, analytics or trackers.
welcome.title: Reading games on the classroom wall
welcome.wall.hint: Tap the letter on the wall or on the phone.
welcome.wall.label: A sample game
welcome.wall.today: Today's rounds use the :pack theme and change every day.
words.add.title: Add a word
words.built_in.description: A word you hide is left out of your games only. Other teachers keep playing it.
words.built_in.title: Built-in words
words.custom.built_in_in: These themes have this word built in and play it there with its picture: :packs.
words.custom.description: Your words play in every theme and in the games of all your classes. Other teachers do not see them.
words.custom.empty: You have no words of your own yet.
words.custom.no_picture: Your own words have no picture, so they are not used in “:game”.
words.custom.title: My words
words.custom.totals: Words and syllables your words give each level:
words.delete.description: “:word” will leave the games of all your classes. Games already started stay as they are.
words.delete.title: Delete this word?
words.description: Add your own words: they play in every theme. You can also hide built-in words of each theme from your games.
words.edit.description: Changes apply from the next game. Games already started stay as they are.
words.edit.title: Edit the word
words.errors.casing: Write the word in lowercase, or a proper noun with only its first letter capital.
words.errors.letters: Type one word in Azerbaijani letters only, with no space, hyphen or sign.
words.errors.no_level: No word level takes a word of :count syllables.
words.errors.no_vowel: The word needs at least one vowel.
words.errors.not_in_pack: This theme has no such built-in word.
words.errors.split: The syllables must join back into the word, with one vowel in each.
words.errors.split_by_rule: This split is the word's own split already.
words.errors.too_many: You can keep at most :max words. Delete one to add another.
words.fields.syllables_help: Leave it empty and the word is split into syllables for you. To fix the split, type the syllables with hyphens, e.g. ki-tab.
words.fields.text_help: One word, in Azerbaijani letters only. Start a proper noun with a capital.
words.title: Words
